answer.answer:
1) This policy (AUT-4472) does not include Rental Reimbursement on the Declarations, so no rental reimbursement benefit is payable under this policy.

2) (For reference) The policy form PP 00 01 06 24 would — if Rental Reimbursement were selected — pay $40 per day for a maximum of 30 days per occurrence, with coverage beginning 24 hours after the loss is reported and ending on the earlier of return to use, payment for a total loss, or the 30-day maximum.

citations.claim: Rental Reimbursement not selected on this policy's Declarations.

citations.source: policy:pp-00-01-06-24.md#PP 00 01 06 24 — Personal Auto Policy > Part IV — Physical Damage Coverage > 4.4 Rental Reimbursement
citations.claim: If Rental Reimbursement is in force on form PP 00 01 06 24, the per-day amount and maximum days (and waiting period) that govern the benefit.
citations.detail:
If your covered auto is withdrawn from use for more than 24 consecutive hours
because of a loss covered under Part IV, we will pay reasonable expenses you
incur for a rental vehicle of a class comparable to your covered auto.

Under form PP 00 01 06 24 we will pay **$40 per day, for a maximum of
30 days** per occurrence.

Coverage begins 24 hours after the loss is reported to us and ends on the
earliest of the day your covered auto is returned to use, the day we pay the
actual cash value for a total loss, or the day the 30-day maximum
is reached.
